payload.reason: The evidence provides information about the baseline systems used for translation, including the types of data and methods employed.

claims.text: The baseline systems for translation include training data from KyTea-segmented Japanese texts and pyvi-segmented Vietnamese texts.
Two baseline systems were built: one using traditional phrase-based statistical machine translation (SMT) and the other using neural machine translation (NMT).
The aim of the NMT systems is to serve as a reproducible baseline for further research in low-resourced language pairs.
